articleTitle: Path Planning Based on Combinaion of Improved A-STAR Algorithm and DWA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: In the path planning of grid map, the influence of node search strategy makes the traditional A-STAR algorithm shown with the defects of non theoretically optimal path in actual path planning, many infection points and many redundant points. Aiming at the deficiency of path planning by traditional algorithm, this paper proposes to eliminate the limitation of node movement direction in traditional A-STAR algorithm by extending its search neighborhood, design a process to remove the redundant sub nodes in the same direction due to neighborhood extension, and combine with velocity evaluation function of the improved DWA algorithm to avoid temporary obstacles. The simulation results show that relative to the traditional A-STAR algorithm, the improved A-STAR algorithm can have shorter path and fewer inflection points; compared with the traditional DWA algorithm, the dynamic path planning combined with the improved A-STAR algorithm and DWA algorithm has fewer nodes and smoother path, which can improve the working security and efficiency of mobile robot in simulation environment.

articleTitle: 5G Boosting Smart Cities Development
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: The construction of smart city promotes the development of modern city, which shows a complex and dynamic process. In addition to cultural factors, it is more involved in the formulation and evolution of specific urban planning, adjustment and transformation of urban space, industry, and population structure, etc. However, the fifth-generation mobile communication technology (5G), as one of the biggest tuyeres of the future information technology revolution, has the ultra-bandwidth, high reliability, low latency, big connection characteristics, the reasonable use of which will undoubtedly provide a new significant auxiliary means for the urban comprehensive treatment. Meanwhile, 5G integrates artificial intelligence (AI), big data, blockchain, Internet of Thins, Industrial Internet and other technologies, to usher in a new era of smart city construction.

articleTitle: Face Recognition Based on MTCNN and Integrated Application of FaceNet and LBP Method
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: Technology of face recognition has developed rapidly in the past three decades. Various face recognition methods have been proposed by a lot of research. The primary objective of the development of face recognition is improving the accuracy. Multi-task Cascaded Convolutional Networks (MTCNN) is an effective method to detect faces, which identifies the position of the face in the picture and marks five landmarks through deep Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). FaceNet is a technology of face recognition, which is also based on CNN technology, exhibit high accuracy. Local Binary Pattern (LBP) is a traditional technology of face recognition. Despite a lower accuracy than FaceNet, it has many advantages such as grayscale invariance and illumination insensitivity. In this research, we propose an enhanced model of face recognition which is based on MTCNN and integrated application of FaceNet and LBP method. The work that described in this article using LBP parallel FaceNet to improve the illumination robustness of the model only consists of MTCNN and FaceNet. Experiments show that the enhanced model is very effective in improving the illumination robustness.

articleTitle: False Data Injection Attack Location Detection Based on Classification Method in Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: The state estimation technology is utilized to estimate the grid state based on the data of the meter and grid topology structure. The false data injection attack (FDIA) is an information attack method to disturb the security of the power system based on the meter measurement. Current FDIA detection researches pay attention on detecting its presence. The location information of FDIA is also important for power system security. In this paper, locating the FDIA of the meter is regarded as a multi-label classification problem. Each label represents the state of the corresponding meter. The ensemble model, the multi-label decision tree algorithm, is utilized as the classifier to detect the exact location of the FDIA. This method does not need the information of the power topology and statistical knowledge assumption. The numerical experiments based on the IEEE-14 bus system validates the performance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Big Data Processing and Application Research
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: Nowadays, big data has become a constantly extended and widely mentioned term. It can excavate, describe and utilize a large amount of structured, unstructured and semi-structured data to obtain more information. With the rapid increase of data, big data has become more and more diverse, and the big data technology has emerged consequently. This paper reviews the literature of big data and the related technologies, such as Hadoop and Map Reduce. And it discusses the life cycle of big data, that is, big data acquisition, preprocessing, storage and analysis. Then it expounds the representative application of big data. Finally, based on the above study, this paper summarizes the development of big data.

articleTitle: Research on Artificial Intelligence Algorithm and Its Application in Games
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: With the in-depth development of intelligent technology, game artificial intelligence (AI) has become the technical core of improving the playability of a game and the main selling point of game promotion, deepening the game experience realm. Modern computer games achieve the realism of games by integrating graphics, physics and artificial intelligence. It is difficult to define the meaning of realistic game experience, but generally speaking, it usually refers to the immersion of the game and the intelligence of non-player characters in the game. As the technical core of improving game playability and the selling point of many commercial games, game artificial intelligence gives players a way to interact with non-player characters in the game, and promotes the realm of game experience to a higher level. Based on this, this paper analyzes the history and present situation of artificial intelligence in game development, and puts forward the possible changes and impacts of artificial intelligence technology based on machine learning on game development in the future.

articleTitle: On the Application of Internet of Things in Smart Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: Being applied in smart agriculture, the technologies of "Internet of Things" (IoT) have given a guarantee to the development of modernized agriculture. Having expounded the connotations of IoT and smart agriculture, this paper will summarize the technologies that are related to the IoT -based Smart Agriculture System and analyze the applications of IoT technologies in smart agriculture. The IoT technologies are applied to various fields, such as agricultural irrigation, pest control, Application in food safety traceability, agricultural circulation, and so on. Being applicable in various fields of smart agriculture, IoT is a promising technology and has become the mainstream in the agricultural development.

articleTitle: Research on Named Entity Recognition for Information Extraction
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: In natural language processing, named entity recognition, as a basic task used in natural language processing, aims at identifying entities with specific meaning in the text, mainly including personal names, place names, institutional names, proper nouns, etc. Named entity recognition technology is an indispensable part of many natural language processing methods, such as information extraction, information retrieval, machine translation and question answering systems. This paper first briefly introduces the developing process of named entity recognition, and describes the basic concept, objectives and difficulties of named entity recognition. Then, it summarizes the methods of named entity recognition from based on rules and dictionary method, based on statistical method, to the deep learning method and migration of learning, and looks forward to the future development of named entity recognition.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis Method of Power System Based on Bayesian Network
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: Fault diagnosis is to estimate the fault state of the system through the observed information. The accuracy of diagnosis results depends on the recognition degree of the diagnosis method to the system fault. In order to deal with the uncertainty issue in fault diagnosis, many methods which combine probability emerge as the times require. Bayesian network is an uncertain reasoning method proposed in the 1980s, which offers a natural and intuitive expression for causal relationship and dependency relationship. It is characterized by strong probabilistic reasoning ability, clear semantics, easy to understand, etc., which has become one of the hot topics in the field of artificial intelligence research. This work first described the basic knowledge from Bayesian theorem to Bayesian network, then extracted a case for analysis, and finally established a corresponding Bayesian network for power system fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Random Vibration Analysis in Mechanical Environment of Satellite Laser Communication Terminal Telescope
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: The accurate mechanical environment signal, simulation and analysis are satellite laser communication terminal telescope plays an important role in promoting the overall design and the related system design, satellite laser communication terminal telescope in the task cycle different stage experience mechanical environment is different, launch period of mechanical environment is given priority to with vibration, characterized by random time space distribution, main influence spacecraft structure, electronic components and related assembly process, etc. In this paper, Solidworks software is used to establish the model of telescope mechanism according to the qualification stage conditions of random vibration test of satellite laser communication terminal telescope. In order to obtain the vibration characteristics of the model, the modal analysis is carried out first. Then, random vibration analysis is carried out in X, Y and Z directions respectively. According to the vibration value given, the random vibration power spectrum is loaded to the model and applied to the mounting surface as a base excitation. Finally, random vibration analysis is carried out for the state model of the telescope mechanism, and three axial deformation and stress response analysis results are obtained. The results of random vibration analysis show that the maximum stress response is 171Mpa when subjected to random vibration, which occurs at the edge of the small boss near the mounting surface of the primary mirror shell. This value is far less than the stress limit of TC4 of structural material, 1140Mpa, so it will not affect the mechanical properties of the whole load. The maximum stress of glass lens is 10.6mpa,This research has important practical significance.

articleTitle: The Research and Implementation of Human Posture Recognition Algorithm Via OpenPose
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: The single-person pose estimation algorithm based on OpenPose and the multi-person pose detection algorithm are used to process the action image of the person collected by the camera to realize the positioning of the key points of the human face, the key points of the human hand, and the various joints of the human body positioning of points; Bresenham algorithm is used to draw lines of the key points of the human body. The accuracy of the traditional human posture recognition algorithm will be reduced when it recognizes the occluded body parts. This paper improves the problem based on OpenPose algorithm. The experimental results show that the method adopted in this paper can adapt to the complex background, and has higher recognition accuracy and operation rate.

articleTitle: Key Security Challenges for Electric Vehicle Charging System
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: With the proliferating of electric vehicles, charging infrastructure has developed rapidly. Meanwhile, security issues of smart charging station system are becoming increasingly serious. In this paper, we systematically analyze the architecture of the charging station system and the protocols between electric vehicles and charging stations. Furthermore, we present the security issues and challenges of the charging station system including charging protocol, TCU, and the communication between the charging station and the vehicle networking platform. As far as we know, our work is the first practical and systematic work for the security analysis of smart electric vehicle charging stations system.

articleTitle: Research on Commodity Image Classification Based on Local Oppugnant Color Vector Angle Pattern
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: Based on the existing commodity image classification research, there is a lack of the use of the most recent color and texture features of the combination of commodity image classification. According to the local oppugnant color vector angle pattern (LOCVAP) feature extraction algorithm and the Deep Believe Network (DBN) classifier, the image classification is simulated and analyzed. The experimental results show that the results of LOCVAP descriptor have a greater improvement than those of other subcategories of feature descriptors.

articleTitle: Research on nondestructive testing of microcracks
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: The traditional ultrasonic nondestructive testing technology generally needs to compare the response data of cracked components and non-destructive components, and analyze the differences between them to identify cracks. The results of the two measurements are easily affected by manual operation errors and changes in external environment, leading to false detection of cracks. Laser ultrasound has the advantages of high resolution and no need to contact the detection object directly. It has far-reaching significance for the detection of damage of materials with complex structure and expensive value. Based on the principle of excitation and reception of laser ultrasound, the detection method of micro damage on the surface of materials by laser ultrasound detection technology is studied in depth. The micro surface of materials including excitation unit, control unit and data acquisition unit is constructed.

articleTitle: Influence of Charging Power of Cable on Voltage and Reactive Power
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: The wide application of cable brings a lot of charging power, which leads to the surplus of reactive power and the high voltage of the system. This paper discusses the theoretical calculation of charging power of the cable in detail, and analyzes the influence of charging power on voltage and reactive power under small load mode combined with the specific example of Fenghuangshan power supply area in Wuhan, Hubei Province. Finally, some control measures such as installing inductive reactive power compensation device are proposed.

articleTitle: Application of Deep Learning in Prediction of Linkage Relationship between Wells
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: Aiming at the prediction problem of interconnection relationship between injection and production wells, a prediction method based on deep learning is proposed. The network structure of injection production wells is established with the center of water injection well location, which is simplified as the flow distribution problem under the conditions of well number, well spacing, angle and physical properties. Through numerical simulation, the distribution amount of various water injection between wells varies with time, and the learning model is optimized by results and parameters optimization, it can achieve high calculation accuracy and has broad application potential.

articleTitle: Design of Simulation Model and Research on Output Characteristics of Solar Cells Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: With the increasingly prominent problems of energy and environment, solar energy is a new energy form with the greatest development potential in the world. As a new type of green renewable energy, solar energy is an ideal renewable energy because of its high utilization rate compared with other new energy sources. Solar photovoltaic power generation is a direct form of power generation that uses photovoltaic panels to convert the radiant energy of sunlight into electrical energy. In the actual situation, the light intensity is unstable, and the solar photovoltaic cells (SPVC) are easily affected by external temperature and other factors, so it is necessary to model the characteristics of photovoltaic array and realize the dynamic simulation of photovoltaic power generation system. This paper introduces the principle of solar photovoltaic cells, designs the simulation model of solar cells based on deep learning, and analyzes the output characteristics of solar cells. Increasing solar radiation, decreasing battery temperature, series resistance and diode reverse saturation current can all improve the output performance of photovoltaic cells, and increasing open circuit voltage and short circuit current is helpful to improve its output power and efficiency.

articleTitle: The Application of Fuzzy Neural Network Based on Network of Ships in Heterogeneous Network
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: With the rise of network of ships, the vertical switching technology of heterogeneous networks is studied in view of the coexistence of various heterogeneous networks, and a vertical switching algorithm based on fuzzy neural network is proposed. The fuzzy neural network processing is carried out by comprehensively considering the signal strength, moving speed, available bandwidth and other factors. The simulation results show that this algorithm can better guarantee the QoS of user's service quality on the basis of reducing ping-pong effect, and verify that this algorithm can effectively improve the accuracy of prediction signal and is suitable for shipboard terminal.

articleTitle: Robust Mobile Location Estimator with NLOS Mitigation using Reconstruction and Regression
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: In recent years, the rapid development of microelectronics technology, computer science and technology, wireless communication technology, promote the progress of low-cost, low-power wireless sensor network (WSN)technology. Its application in various fields, especially in target tracking, has attracted more and more attention of scholars. Non-line-of-sight (NLOS) propagation is a valuable question in wireless sensor network positioning. Especially in indoor environments where positioning accuracy is highly demanded, precise positioning of moving targets is still a difficult problem due to the continuous switching of LOS and NLOS environments. Commen filters such as the extended Kalman filter (EKF) has a poor performance because they are sensitive to outliers. In these paper, we propose a robust mobile terminal location method based on reconstruction and Regression. We identify the propagation channal with GMM. Then a limiting filter is employed to migate the NLOS error, and regression is uesed to smoothing the positioning result. The simulation results show that the method has good positioning accuracy.

articleTitle: A Tongue Segmentation Algorithm Based on LBP Feature and Cascade Classifier
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: To identify and locate the tongue body from the image is the first step for computer-aided diagnosis of tongue image in traditional Chinese medicine. But it is difficult to do in a tongue image with uneven illumination or uncertain position tongue body. In this paper, a tongue recognition and localization method based on LBP feature and cascade classifier is proposed. Firstly, LBP features of tongue bodies and other images are extracted from the training set respectively. The AdaBoost cascade classifier is trained on these features. Then, each test image is preprocessed by Gaussian filtering, HSV color space conversion and histogram equalization. By using a sliding window on the test image, LBP features of each pixel block are extracted and sent to the classifier to complete tongue recognition and localization. Experimental results show that this method has a high recognition rate for tongue bodies with different sizes and positions in test images, which is of great significance for the subsequent tongue image classification.

articleTitle: Intelligent Control and Energy Conservation of Ball Mill
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: Jiajiapu Iron Mine processes low-grade ore with 20%~40% iron content. To meet pellet plant production needs, bigger iron concentrate output is required. A grinding intelligent control system is established in view of difficult grinding and selection of low-grade ore. A variety of electronic instruments are taken for real-time online monitoring of operating parameters and intelligent control of the production process, thereby realizing integrated production process management and control. Mill processing capacity is enlarged on the premise of stable concentrate particle size to increase grinding efficiency and concentrate production, continuously perfect production process, optimize energy use and reduce energy consumption.

articleTitle: Innovative Design of an Intelligent Wheelchair
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: In view of the difficulties in getting up and the unsanitary way of toilet treatment for the disabled, the elderly and other people in need of wheelchair, and a toilet assisted wheelchair was designed. As far as this wheelchair is concerned, the device adopts single chip microcomputer for intelligent control and has two main functions: assisting wheelchair users to get up on the wheelchair and collecting their excreted pollutants. The experiment shows that: compared with similar products, the toilet assisted wheelchair is more ergonomic in helping to get up, and more convenient and hygienic in solving toilet problems. It is of great significance to help people with wheelchair in daily life.

articleTitle: Design of Curtain Automatic Control System Based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: At present, in the process of opening and closing the curtains, because people in the interior of the time is limited, can not be timely and effective control curtains according to the room outside of the light intensity and the indoor temperature, thus resulting in the best effect can not get curtains of the problem, so put forward a kind of automatic control system of STM32 based on the curtains. The system comprises a temperature sensor module, a light sensor module, a clock module, a motor module, a liquid crystal display module and a manual control module. After the actual test, the system is simple and convenient, can carry automatic and manual mode to open and close the curtain, can meet the actual needs, can be a wide range of promotion.

articleTitle: Optimization of Temperature Curve of Reflow Welding Furnace Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: The surface assembly of welding furnace is an important part in the production of electronic products such as integrated circuit board. The accurate control of the process temperature of each part of the welding furnace is directly related to the quality of the finished product. Minimal error can lead to virtual welding, plate burning and other problems. At present, the research on this problem focuses on the influence of process parameters on the temperature curve, and the direct control of welding furnace temperature is insufficient. Based on the artificial intelligence algorithm, the temperature determination of welding furnace is divided into four angles, from the establishment of mathematical model of temperature change in welding area under given temperature zone to the optimization of furnace temperature curve under given limit conditions. The temperature control problems in welding furnace production are solved by model step by step.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Kinematic Characteristics of Plane Flip Four-Bar Linkage Based on Adams
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: This paper takes the coordinated drug delivery device in the ammunition automatic loading system as the research objective. Based on the initial design of the structure, the main components of the turnover mechanism and the turnover trajectory are simplified. The three-dimensional linkage mechanism is simplified to a planar linkage mechanism. Select the structural parameters of its key components as design variables, minimize the acceleration amplitude of the center of mass of the cartridge during the movement process as the optimization objective function, and perform parametric modeling and optimization simulation analysis on the plane flip four-bar linkage, and finally get The objective function is the optimal solution, and the optimization result of the structural parameters of the key components of the plane flip four-bar linkage is obtained.

articleTitle: Design of maritime satellite launch platform
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: The location of the launching rocket can be selected at sea to complete the launch task more flexibly. If you want to save fuel, you can choose to launch at the equator to increase the rocket's carrying capacity. In addition, because there are fewer human activities at sea, there can be a wider range of recovery of rocket wreckage. In the aerospace field, launching rockets at sea is of great significance. In order to meet this demand, this article analyzes marine launch rockets and designs a platform that can be used for maritime launch rockets to provide references for other researchers to study related content.

articleTitle: Study on thermal effect of LiFePO4/C battery with different capacity retention rate in adiabatic environment
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: The life of the new LiFePO4/C battery with prelithiation technology has been greatly improved. In the life-cycle management of this kind of long-life lithium ion battery, attention should be paid to the change of battery resistance and the change of thermal effect during charge/discharge process, so as to accurately evaluate its health state and adjust its thermal management strategy. In this paper, battery samples with prelithiation technology under different capacity retention rates (100%, 91.72%, 75.57% and 67.78/%) were studied. By comparing with conventional batteries with same capacity, the change of internal resistance (total resistance, ohmic resistance, polarization resistance) and the discharge thermal effect of batteries with different capacity retention rates in adiabatic environment were analysed.

articleTitle: Design of fatigue endurance experiment method for automotive torsion beam based on rain-flow method
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: In the process of modern vehicle design and manufacture, Prediction through experimental methods and structural improvement of chassis components are an important part of improving the fatigue durability of vehicle structures. In this paper, the fatigue damage test of a vehicle is carried out by analyzing the fatigue vibration of a vehicle torsion beam member, premature failure and failure occurred. Based on the test data and results of MTS test bed, the failure analysis and life prediction of the key component are carried out. In the test design, the rain flow counting method is used to process and transform the pavement spectrum load data. According to the test results, local stress strain method and Miner criterion are used to estimate the fatigue damage of torsional beam. Finally, the damage of the torsion beam of this model was obtained through the test bench loading road spectrum test, and the main damage points were obtained through the comparative analysis of the fatigue damage prediction results. It is of great significance to study the improvement and optimization of torsion beams.

articleTitle: Application of High Precision 3D Geological Modeling in Horizontal Well Development of Tight Gas Reservoir
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: The southeastern part of Sulige gas field is a typical tight sandstone gas reservoir with frequent channel bifurcations and intersections. The contact mode of single sand body is mainly multi-layer contact formed by lateral accretion. It has been proved by practice that the production of single well can be increased by tackling key problems in horizontal wells, and the development with less wells and more production can be realized. In recent years, based on the geological knowledge base, the combination of well and seismic, and the increase of horizontal well data and other geological constraints as much as possible, the formation of multi-disciplinary integration of high-precision three-dimensional geological model, the realization of sand body internal configuration step-by-step description, fine anatomy of sand body spatial superposition relationship and distribution characteristics, fine guidance of horizontal well deployment and LWD guidance. Through lithofacies and attribute model, the distribution law of gas reservoir is determined; combined with the calculation model of geological reserves abundance, the advantageous position of reservoir development is optimized, and the factors such as well pattern and well type are integrated to deploy high-quality horizontal well location; based on the identification of high-precision sand body and effective sand body, the design trajectory of horizontal well is optimized to effectively reduce the large-scale up-down adjustment in the drilling process of horizontal section Through comprehensive analysis of the model, fine adjustment and real-time steering are carried out while drilling performance of horizontal wells, and the drilling encounter rate of horizontal wells is increased by 5% - 10%. The application of the new technology of 3D geological modeling can realize the well location deployment with quality and quantity basis, and improve drilling speed and quality and benefit. Under the background of poor reservoir quality, the development effect of horizontal well is ensured.

articleTitle: Research on the Applicability of Benford’s Law in Chinese Texts
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: This paper aims to research the applicability of Benford's Law in Chinese texts. Firstly, the Chinese corpus was collected and word segmentation was performed. The distributions of the first digit of frequency were calculated for words, low-frequency words and single characters respectively in Chinese texts, and the relative entropy (Kullback-Leibler distance) between the distributions and the general Benford's law. Secondly, the parameter value range of the Generalized Benford's law was researched, and in view of the limitation of Zipf's law that is only applicable to large amounts of data, we carried out a statistical analysis of small-scale data. Then, the experimental analysis of the probability of the first digit of the word frequency of the single character data was carried out to explore the applicability of the Generalized Benford's law for single-character data. Finally, the applicability of Benford's law was investigated for artificially modified corpus. The results show that the words and characters in Chinese texts conform to the Benford's law, and Benford's law overcomes the limitation of Zipf's law on the size of the data sets, and the Generalized Benford's law has the ability to discriminate the natural quality of the corpus, which has important practical significance for Chinese information processing.

articleTitle: Experiment on the relationship between the characteristics of flowback liquid ions and the complexity of hydraulic fractures in shale
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: The evaluation of the effect of hydraulic fracturing is the focus of shale gas safety and economic exploitation, and evaluation of the complexity of hydraulic fractures is a major difficulty. In order to better evaluate the complexity of shale gas fracturing fractures, based on the characteristics of ion exchange between fracturing fluid and shale formation, the flowback fluid ion changes, and a core immersion experiment that simulates the flowback of fracturing fluid is carried out. The immersion experiment simulates the continuous immersion process of cores representing different levels of complex fractures in deionized water under formation temperature conditions, and tests the ion types and concentrations and hydrogen and oxygen isotopes of the aqueous solution at different times. The ion concentration changes of the aqueous solution under different fracture complexity conditions are compared and analyzed, and the ion source is analyzed based on the results of core mineral and element analysis. The results showed that the Na<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> content is the highest in the aqueous solution, and the concentration change over time is the most obvious, and the Na<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> concentration in complex slits is higher than that in branch slits and single slits. The concentration of Si<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4+</sup> and B<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> is lower than that of Na<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>, and their change over time is similar to that of Na<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>. The total salinity of aqueous solution changes stepwise with time, and the total salinity in complex fractures is higher than that of branched and single fractures. Various trace elements in the aqueous solution mainly come from the dissolution of the elements adsorbed on the clay minerals, and some of them come from the dissolution of minerals. By comparing and analyzing the characteristics of Na<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> and Si<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4+</sup> plasma changes in the flowback fluid, combined with other means of monitoring fractures, the complexity of the fractures can be better evaluated and provide guidance for safe and economic exploitation of shale gas.

articleTitle: Simulation study on consequence of leakage accident of liquid chlorine storage tank
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: In this paper, Aloha accident consequence simulation software was used to simulate the accident consequence of liquid chlorine tank leakage. The influence of wind speed, leakage aperture, ambient temperature and humidity on the hazard range of liquid chlorine leakage was discussed. The results showed that when the temperature increases, the cloud coverage decreases, the area of leakage hole increases, the height of leakage hole decreases and the roughness of diffusion terrain decreases, the dangerous diffusion area of liquid chlorine leakage will increase, otherwise it will decrease. When the wind speed is 1-3m / s, the dangerous concentration area of liquid chlorine leakage increases with the increase of wind speed, while when the wind speed is 3-10m / s, the dangerous concentration area of liquid chlorine leakage decreases with the increase of wind speed.

articleTitle: A Novel Trapezoid Digital Filter Algorithm to Tackle Pulse PileUp Problems for Spectrometer Signal Processing
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: For an ideal pulse pileup situation, this paper establishes a triangle-trapezoid dual-channel shaping algorithm by analyzing the correlation between trapezoid and triangle shaping results. In this model, the effective pulses in many pulse pileup situations are preserved, which greatly improves the count rate of the pulse spectra. In this paper, the pulse acquisition process is modeled in MATLAB. The input of the model is the negative exponential decay pulses obtained by discrete direct sampling of the actual spectra, and the effectiveness of the optimization algorithm is verified by inputting different levels of pulse pileup signals. The results show that the improved triangle-trapezoid dual-channel shaping algorithm can more accurately retain the effective pulse values under pulse pileup, improve the count rate of the spectra, and ultimately improve the resolution of the pulse spectra.

articleTitle: Research on recommendation system based on integrating semantic similarity
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: The collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm ignores the semantic relationship between the recommendation item and the user, so this paper proposes an improved collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm that fuses semantic similarity of recommended items. This paper aims to improve the performance of the problem of ignoring the relationship between items and data sparsity in collaborative filtering recommendation. First, TransH algorithm was used to extract the relationship between users and movie entities, Second, the similarity between recommended items is calculated and integrated into the similarity matrix of user ratings, which makes up for the fact that the item based collaborative filtering algorithm does not consider the similarity between items. The experimental results show that this collaborative filtering recommendation system based on integrating semantic similarity has good performance in precision, recall and coverage.

articleTitle: A Bionic Strategy of Chemical Plume Tracing on Autonomous Underwater Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of tracing and positioning the chemical plume of autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) in the water environment, combined with the advantages of the stability and real-time performance of the bionic tracing method, a behavior-based bionic tracing and positioning method is proposed and the corresponding behavior conversion method. At the same time, the five main behaviors proposed are explained and explained in detail, and simulation experiments are carried out. The simulation experiments result is verified that the proposed behavior-based bionic tracing and positioning method can efficiently complete the plume tracing and positioning task, and has a high success rate.

articleTitle: A Tracking Control Method for Autonomous Intelligent Park Vehicle Based on Model Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: In order to make our autonomous intelligent park vehicles against established track has a good path tracking effect, a path tracking control method based on model prediction control (MPC) is proposed, using particle swarm optimization algorithm control to automatically calculate and adjust the MPC controller parameters under different working conditions. The CarSim/Simulink co-simulation platform is built to complete path following control simulation for dual lane under various speed. The simulation and experiment show that the intelligent vehicle in the parks has a good accuracy in following the target path under the control strategy.

articleTitle: Analysis on Tribological Performance and Leakage Characteristics of Porous Bearings
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: Although the structure of porous metal bearings is simple, they are widely used in the mechanical field. With the enterprise porous bearings for fan taken as the research object, tribological performance and leakage characteristics of the bearings are calculated and analyzed in this paper. According to the actual working conditions of the bearing, a mechanical model is established to solve the basic mechanical parameters. Based on the mathematical model about temperature change, the effect of different diametrical running clearance on the friction coefficient and temperature rise when the bearing reaches thermal equilibrium is analyzed. Finally, the effects of the bearing length, the diametrical running clearance, the bearing outside diameter and the bearing porosity on bearing leakage are quantitatively studied according to principle of thermal expansion. Theoretical results show that reasonable control of diametrical running clearance, bearing outside diameter and bearing porosity will conduce more to bearing lubrication and reduce the bearing leakage, thus the service life of porous bearings is prolonged.

articleTitle: Design of A Trans-Media Aircraft Morphing Wing Structure
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: The trans-media aircraft refers to a new concept special aircraft that can both fly through the air and dive underwater, which has a broad prospect of military application. To make sure the aircraft can move smoothly in both media with low resistance, the design of the aircraft should pay attention to the needs of both air flying and underwater prowling in terms of shape and structure. This paper designs a kind of morphing wing, borrowing from bionics design philosophy, which could fold when the aircraft is diving underwater and then unfold when it is flying through the air.

Author Keywords: morphing wing structure and aerodynamic characteristics

articleTitle: Background Deduction Approach Based on Iterative Adaptive Window-Based Wavelet Transform and Gaussian Convolution Filtering for XRF
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: In the X-Ray fluorescence (XRF) analysis, valid characteristic peaks of elements are often superimposed on low-frequency backgrounds, which harm the qualitative and quantitative analysis of elements. Therefore, background deduction is an essential part of spectral pre-processing. To address the above issue, this paper proposes a new method for background deduction which combines iterative adaptive window-based wavelet transform (IAWWT) with iterative Gaussian convolution filtering (IGCF). To verify the validity of the proposed algorithm in this paper, XRF spectra of 59 soil standards are obtained. Firstly, background deduction is performed on the spectra by using IDWT, IAWWT, IGCF, and the method proposed in this paper. Secondly, the peak areas of Cr, Mn, and Cu in the spectra are linearly fitted to the true contents of the samples. The results show that the proposed method can effectively deduct the background, and the goodness of fit ( R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> ) of Cr, Mn, and Cu is better than the other three methods after background deduction. Among them, R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> of Cr increases to 0.99, R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> of Mn increases to 0.96, and R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> of Cu increases to 0.97.

articleTitle: Cutting Forces Coefficient Calibration
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: The cutting forces of flank milling is an important part of the simulation of the milling process, which affects the chatter monitoring, tool life, and surface quality of the workpiece. In this paper, a mechanistic cutting force model is proposed to predict the cutting force of the flat end milling cutter. The cutting force coefficient is calibrated and verified by the slot milling experiment on the three-axis machine with least square method. The result shows that the model has high prediction accuracy, which can meet the industrial processing requirement.

articleTitle: Short-term Power Load Forecasting Model Based on Model Fusion
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: Power load forecasting plays a vital role in ensuring the safe and stable operation of power system, ensuring the reliability of power supply and improving social and economic benefits. Short-term load forecasting is the basis of power grid operation and is generally used to make generation and dispatching plans. At the same time, accurate short-term load forecasting results can reduce the cost of power generation and improve economic benefits. Short-term load forecasting is of great significance to the optimization of generation side and user side two-way dispatching and the improvement of power energy efficiency. In this work, a short-term power load forecasting model based on blending model fusion was established by combining machine learning algorithms such as extreme learning machine, random forest, XGBoost, wavelet neural network, etc. The forecasting model is expected to offer accurate short-term load forecasting and ensure the balance between supply and demand of power grid, thus ensuring the economic, reliable, high-quality and efficient power supply of power grid.

articleTitle: Compaction characteristics and permeability evolution characteristics of broken coal body under triaxial stress
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: In the process of coal mining, the compaction characteristics of the goaf and its permeability evolution characteristics are critical to the safe and efficient mining of coal mines, which directly affect surface subsidence, air leakage in the goaf and spontaneous combustion of coal. Although the stress and permeability of the goaf are very important, it is difficult to directly measure the stress and permeability of the goaf. Therefore, this paper uses the damaged coal and rock mass seepage test system to carry out the compaction and seepage tests of the broken coal mass under triaxial loading. The experimental shows that: (1) under the same stress, the strain of a single-size coal sample is smaller than the mixed particle size, and the porosity is greater than the mixed particle size. The larger the particle size of a single-size coal sample, the smaller its strain. (2) There are two stages of rapid compaction and slow compaction under the condition of triaxial compression of broken coal samples. The strain and permeability stress sensitivity of the rapid compaction stage are strong, while the slow compaction stage is weak. (3) Under triaxial loading of broken coal, permeability has an exponential relationship with effective stress, and a power function relationship with porosity, which obeys Darcy's law. The research results are of great significance for guiding the goaf gas drainage and preventing surface subsidence and spontaneous combustion of the goaf coal.

articleTitle: Design of a Cylindrical Conformal Wideband Power Division and Phase Shifter
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: In this paper, a cylindrical conformal wideband power distribution phase shifter is presented. Wideband power divider and phase shifter are printed on the surface of the cylindrical substrate with high dielectric constant, and the inside is a hollow metal cylinder. This network consists of a wideband 180° phase shifter, two wideband 90° phase shifters and three Wilkinson power dividers. The wideband phase shifter consists of a microstrip transmission line, a pair of open circuits and a pair of short circuits. By adjusting the impedance and length of open circuit or short circuit, the phase and bandwidth of the output port of microstrip transmission line can be varied. Therefore, the wideband impedance matching is realized and the phase shift bandwidth is widened. The computer simulation results show that in the bandwidth range of 1.22 GHz to 1.82 GHz, the reflection coefficient of the input ports is less than -10dB, the S parameters of the four output ports are about -6.8dB, the amplitude difference of the four ports is less than 0.55dB, and the phases of the four output ports are about 0°, 90°, 180° and 270°, with an error of less than ±5°.

articleTitle: Study on Preparation of PAA Template Based on 2-D Photonic Crystal Application
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: In order to produce the 2-D photonic crystal structure that meets the demand of optical band, the mixed solution of phosphoric acid and oxalic acid was selected to prepare PAA template. PAA template is an alumina membrane with nanoscale array structure. By adjusting oxalic acid concentration in 1wt% phosphoric acid solution and monitoring current change during anodic oxidation, a PAA template with adjustable array period and highly ordered array units was completed. Due to the requirement of photonic crystal structure, PAA template should be separated from the aluminum plate and the array hole should be through hole. Step-by-step voltage decrement method was used for post-treatment, and the relationship between the through-hole condition of PAA template and the treatment time of 1wt% phosphoric acid solution was studied.

articleTitle: Wireless RF Powered Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: The nodes in wireless sensor networks (WSNs) are generally powered by batteries, whose available power is very limited, and it is difficult or even impossible to replace the batteries. However, WSNs requires months or even years to survive. In recent years, WSNs, which can capture energy in the environment, has been paid more and more attention. Thereinto, WSNs powered by radio frequency (RF) is a very promising one. This paper focuses on the survey of wireless RF powered sensor networks.

articleTitle: SSC-LINAC Control System Based on PLCs
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: The control system of SSC-LINAC includes ion source control system, vacuum control system, condition monitoring system, and equipment safety interlock system. EPICS distributed control is used to establish a system architecture. PLC is used as the main hardware to control vacuum valves, monitor magnets temperature and build equipment safety interlock system. The control system is stable and reliable, and no failure occurs during operation. The response time of the equipment safety interlock system is within 50ms, which can fully meet the requirements of system design.

articleTitle: Research on Ethical Issues of Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: In the information age, the application of artificial intelligence technology has attracted wide attention from people from all walks of life, especially with the rapid development and wide application of artificial intelligence technology, people focus on the "ethical issues" brought by artificial intelligence. With the continuous development of artificial intelligence technology, it is becoming more and more popular in production and life, which inevitably brings a series of ethical issues worth pondering. While cheering for the revolution of artificial intelligence, many people have raised concerns about artificial intelligence. In the past, the hidden worry that only appeared in science fiction works suddenly seemed to be only one step away from people. In the development of the new generation of artificial intelligence, the ethical issues of intelligent algorithms gradually show a new development trend, and an ethical dimension is appearing more and more clearly at the junction of science and philosophy in the way of overall infiltration. This paper expounds the ethical dilemma brought by artificial intelligence, and based on this, puts forward effective breakthrough strategies on how to solve the ethical dilemma of artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: The Method for Evaluating Rope-jumping Posture
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: Nowadays as living standard has greatly improved, most of people pay more attention to their health. As a result, rope-jumping has become one of the main ways to maintain health because of its advantages of consuming extra nutrition and improving physical fitness. However, improper posture and excessive amount of training may increase the burden of the body or even cause damage on the body. Therefore, in this paper a method of using a single waist-fixed accelerometer to quantify rope-jumping movement was investigated and evaluated. Based on the analysis of the acceleration trend of a single rope jump, the parameters and corresponding calculation methods for evaluating the motion posture were proposed, and by collecting and analyzing 10 groups of detected sensor data of the standard posture and the high jump posture respectively, the proposed parameters were proved that the difference between two kinds of posture could be well distinguished. This indicates that proposed parameters can be applied in recognizing other rope-jumping posture and furthermore used in correcting wrong jumping posture.

articleTitle: Robust Dual Concept Factorization for Data Clustering
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: Concept factorization approximates the original data matrix with concepts and coefficients by minimizing the squared loss and has been widely used for data representation and clustering. The graph regularization has also been adopted on both sides of the factorization. In this paper, we propose the novel robust dual concept factorization method to improve the robustness against outliers and noises. In particular, we take the dual concept factorization model and use the corr-entropy induced metric to guide the data reconstruction and the corresponding dual graph regularization. As a result, the affect of the outliers can be alleviated from both data reconstruction and dual regularization. Performance also validates the method proposed to group data on reference data sets.

articleTitle: Research on uniaxial stress compression mechanical properties and uniaxial stress failure mode of pre-cracked rock
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: Based on the crack initiation, expansion and coalescence of the rock itself under the action of compressive load, it will cause the collapse and instability of the rock mass structure. This paper uses the self-developed stress loading equipment, rock mass tomography scanner and high-speed camera to analyze the sandstone samples. Perform uniaxial compression mechanical properties and compression failure characteristics tests. The results show that the change trend of the axial stress-strain curve of the single pre-cracked sandstone specimen and the complete sample sandstone is approximately the same. The mechanical parameters such as the yield strength, yield strain and elastic modulus of the single-cracked sandstone specimen under uniaxial compression are far lower than the complete sample sandstone specimen. The yield strength of the pre-cracked sandstone specimens increases with the increase of the pre-crack angle. When the porosity of the sandstone specimen remains unchanged, the elastic modulus of a single pre-cracked sandstone specimen is approximately the same, and both are less than the elastic modulus of the complete specimen. There are three typical cracks in the pre-cracked sandstone specimen during uniaxial compression: wing cracks, coplanar secondary cracks and inclined secondary cracks. This paper provides an improvement and supplement to the experimental mechanics performance for the theoretical basis for predicting the collapse and failure of engineering rock mass structures.

articleTitle: Technique Support System Design of Electric Dispatching Automation Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: Through the analysis of real-time data and historical data mining in power grid operation, we can master the operation law of power grid, optimize the power system resources, and construct the technical support system of electric dispatching automation to improve the security and reliability of the power grid. This paper discusses the integration, storage, analysis and display technology of power big data. The technical support system based on big data technology includes the equipment maintenance management module, operation model management module, scheduling task management module and resource allocation management module. The experiment shows that TFFB of the system is always within the range of receiving in the case of high concurrent access, and the performance of the system can meet the application requirements.

articleTitle: Conical Dielectric Lens Loaded Frequency-Diverse Bunching Meta Material Aperture
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: A conical dielectric lens based frequency-diverse bunching meta material aperture (FDBMA) is proposed in this paper. The FDBMA consists of a frequency-diverse transmission meta material aperture (FDTMA) to produce different radiation patterns at different frequencies and a conical dielectric lens (CDL) to bunch the radiation patterns generated by the FDTMA. Firstly, the FDTMA that consists of a frequency-diverse metalens and a circular array is designed. F urthermore, a CDL is designed to bunch the radiation patterns generated by the FDTMA and the dip angle of the CDL is optimized. Finally, the reflection coefficient (i.e., S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf>), radiation efficiency and correlation coefficient of FDBMA were evaluated. The radiation patterns generated by the FDBMA can be used as a measurement pattern in accordance with coincidence imaging. All of the results are validated through simulation results.

articleTitle: The Common RNN Based Models with Sequence Tagging
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: Sequence tagging is a very important and basic research direction in the field of natural language processing. The performance of many top-level NLP tasks largely depends on the accuracy and reliability of sequence tagging. Correlation model has made a significant progress in this field. At present, the focus of research is how to make better use of the correlation and timing between data to sequence tagging tasks on the premise of ensuring robustness, so as to achieve further performance. In this paper, we summarize the highlights and breakthrough research results and research models in the field of sequence tagging in recent years, mainly from the models, data sets, parameters and performance. At the same time, we summarize the existing problems and look forward to the future.

articleTitle: Force analysis and improved design of piezomagnetic force sensor
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: Piezomagnetic force sensor is a kind of force sensor used in heavy load and harsh working environment. It has the characteristics of large range and low sensitivity. Aiming at improving the shortcomings of traditional piezomagnetic sensors, this paper proposes a design scheme of the sensor's piezomagnetic element, and carries out the modeling. The finite element simulation is performed with ANSYS, but the simulation results show that the force of the piezomagnetic element does not meet the requirements. On this basis, two improved schemes of piezomagnetic elements are proposed and simulated. Finally, it is concluded that the design of the excitation winding as a cross shaped piezomagnetic component can not only respond to the existing load and improve the sensitivity of the sensor, but also can measure the force in the two directions leading to the excitation winding, so as to increase the measurement dimension.

articleTitle: Intelligent Base Electricity Consumption Calculation for the Resumption of Work
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: A trivial way to analyze the work and production resumption situation is based on a fixed-base electricity consumption calculation. To provide more reasonable results, we propose a novel analysis method, which is based on the dynamic-base calculation. It mainly focuses on electricity consumption on a similar date and the upper quartile of the average monthly consumption from the previous year. In this method, we also introduce a matching algorithm of similar dates and a distance function over dates to find the date in the same periods. The results show that the work and production resumption rate calculated by our method is more reasonable than others.

articleTitle: Research on high accuracy gearbox fault classification method
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: In order to improve the intelligence of the gearbox fault diagnosis system, this paper uses BP neural network as the core algorithm to study gearbox fault diagnosis. First, the wavelet packet decomposition algorithm is used to decompose the gearbox vibration signal into 8 different frequency bands. Use the energy values of 8 frequency bands as the characteristic vector of the gearbox vibration signal, train the BP neural network, and determine the structural parameters of the BP neural network. The network is used to classify 4 types of gearbox fault signals. Each type of fault signal has 65 groups, a total of 260 groups of signals. The classification results show that the accuracy rate is above 95%.It shows that the wavelet packet algorithm is used to decompose the gearbox vibration signal, and the BP network is trained with the feature vector composed of energy values of different frequency bands. The network has good fault recognition performance.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Process Parameters and Equipment Failure Analysis of Melt Blown Die Head
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: Double slit nozzles are widely used in meltblown equipment. In the production process, two high-speed and high-temperature hot air jets from two air gaps on both sides of the spinneret hole and converges to stretch and refine the polymer melt extruded from the spinneret hole. In this paper, the Reynolds stress model is selected as the turbulence model, the governing equations of the Reynolds stress model are determined, the governing equations of the Reynolds stress model are discretized, and the difference equations of the governing equations are obtained, and the simple algorithm is selected to solve these difference equations. The velocity vector diagram of the flow field is obtained by numerical simulation, and three rules are obtained: the inclination angle of the fiber increases gradually in the process of movement, and the outer end of the fiber is gradually away from the spinning line, that is, the fiber has the trend of outward diffusion; with the increase of the initial air velocity, the distance of the fiber from the spinning line increases vertically; the closer to the die head, the smaller the inclination angle of the fiber.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Measurement and Control System of Warehouse Temperature and Humidity
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: In order to accelerate the process of unmanned management of temperature and humidity control in a specific environment, a measurement and control system based on STC89C52 single-chip microcomputer, SHT10 sensor and relay is designed. The system uses a single-chip microcomputer to control the working status of the sensor, collect the temperature and humidity signals output by the sensor's own A/D, and display the measured value. When the measured value is inconsistent with the set value, the relay module is started to heat or cool the environment, or humidify or dry, until it is consistent with the set value. It is proved by experiments that the system has realized the predetermined function. Through software compensation, the accuracy of temperature measurement can reach 0.1°C and the accuracy of humidity measurement can reach 0.1%RH. When the measured value is inconsistent with the set value, the system can start the relay to work and issue an alarm, which is reliable.

articleTitle: The Load Portrait Method for Urban Substation Based on Clustering
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: At present, the analysis of electricity consumption characteristics mainly focuses on the profiling method at the user level. Low-voltage substation is also an important dimension of power consumption in the power grid. The load portrait of substation can help the managers to understand the load features of substations in time and accurately, which is pivotal for the data mining of substation load data and the decision-making of various scenarios. In this paper, based on daily power consumption data and real-time load data, a method of extracting labels of load data is proposed and a label system for substations is built. The load portrait of the substation is obtained by cluster analysis based on the generated labels. Finally, the case study based on the data of 19012 substations in Shanghai is conducted, and the labels and load portrait are obtained.

articleTitle: Collision Attack Framework on RIPEMD-128
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: In the last few years, the hash functions are the very common and essential primitives implemented in lots of fields. RIPEMD-128, a member of MD-family hash function, has been found collisions on the full round. In this paper, we further analyze the property about the security against collision attack of RIPEMD-128. The collision attack framework for RIPEMD-128 is proposed in order to provide ideas for other hash functions. The framework consists of three parts namely choosing a message word difference insertion, constructing differential characteristics and collision search phase. Cryptographic techniques including message modification is also introduced to reduce the complexity.

articleTitle: Machine Vision Based Segmentation of the Goldplate Area from a Flexible Printed Circuit Board
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: Inspection of flexible printed circuit board (FPCB) is a crucial process in the manufacture industry. Besides, edge detection and extraction of the region of interest (ROI) is always a main issue. An effective segmentation method helps to reduce the influence of the irrelevant factors, thus largely augment the performance of defect inspection in the following process. In this paper, a method of segmentation of the gold finger area of FPCB was proposed to solve the problem of adhesion between gold finger and cover film. First, a Gaussian filter was applied to the grayscale image. Second, a blurry edge image was obtained by the residual image between the Gaussian image and the other after an erosion operation. Third, a binary image was created by using an adaptive threshold method, and finally, with the application of histogram statistic, the rectangle area of gold finger was extracted. Experimental results show that the proposed method accurately locate the gold finger area for our FPCB images. In addition, it takes 2.654s to extract the ROI with the adaptive threshold and 1.442s without it. By feeding it to a classifier, a total time of 3.903s was spent to analyze the possible defects, which means the algorithm is suitable for automated optical inspection (AOI) for FPCBs.

articleTitle: Exploration on Prevention and Maintenance of Common Faults of Hydraulic Machinery Equipment Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: Mechanical hydraulic system has the advantages of high transmission efficiency, large transmission energy, good transmission stability, small transmission wear, flexible arrangement and compact structure. As long as there are few faults in the hydraulic system, the machinery can't work smoothly. Therefore, it is of great significance for manufacturing enterprises to maintain hydraulic facilities and solve their faults accurately, quickly and in a short time. Due to the limitation of technical conditions and complex working conditions, the fault diagnosis function of hydraulic mechanical equipment is still weak at present. In the process of fault prevention and maintenance, a more efficient maintenance plan should be scientifically formulated in combination with the actual situation of specific equipment. In this paper, the frequent faults of hydraulic system of mechanical equipment are analyzed, and the construction method of big data decision analysis service platform is discussed, so as to realize the remote online fault diagnosis of hydraulic mechanical equipment, thus improving the maintainability and availability of hydraulic mechanical equipment.

articleTitle: Research on Mechanical Design and Manufacture Based on Multi-Agent and Its Automation Application
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: With the rapid development of science and technology in China, the design and manufacture of machinery and its automation have gradually penetrated into our country. Nowadays, this mechanical technology has been accepted by many industries, and more and more mechanical design enterprises are gradually developing towards automation. The realization of mechanical automation means that we can save a lot of manpower, and the industrial output will increase. People need to pay attention to rest while machines don't use it, so the realization of mechanical automation has always been our goal. Compared with traditional mechanical equipment, automatic mechanical equipment has the advantages of simple operation and low dependence on human resources, which is of great significance to the promotion of economic benefits of various production enterprises in society, and further promotes the continuous acceleration of social and economic development. This paper mainly analyzes the actual situation of design, manufacture and automation of multi-agent machinery, explores its existing problems, and puts forward some corresponding solutions, hoping to promote the development of science and technology and improve China's comprehensive national strength.

articleTitle: Research on Real-time Online Mechanical State Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: FPGA has the characteristics of high flexibility, high parallelism and high integration, and has been more and more used in the past ten years. LabVIEW has a powerful graphical environment, direct reading through the computer serial port, and can analyze and process test data in real time. This paper designs an online mechanical state detection system based on FPGA and LabVIEW. The system uses FPGA as the core unit. It realizes signal sampling, conversion, transmission and storage. Use LabVIEW as the development platform to establish a graphical soft panel for the detection system. The user operates the graphical soft interface through the keyboard or mouse to realize the functions of displaying the collected data, starting the data processing and displaying the processing results. The results show that the system is low in price, strong in anti-interference ability, easy to operate, and friendly in interface, which is of great significance to the detection of operating mechanical faults.

articleTitle: A novel prescribed performance control model with ESO to optimize trajectory tracking for quadrotor UAV
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: In the study of trajectory tracking of the quadrotor UAV, there exists two major problems: external interference and tracking estimation error. Based on the extended state observer (ESO), a unilateral no-overshoot fast convergence model with Novel Prescribed Performance Control (NPPC) mechanism is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the quadrotor UAV is transformed into an external loop position and an inner loop attitude control system. A novel error transform function is proposed for the limitation that the former prescribed performance control scheme cannot achieve rapid convergence of the system state. Secondly, the controllers are designed by the position subsystem and the attitude subsystem, according to the backstepping method and the ESO are designed to estimate external interference. Finally, it is combined with dynamic surface control to realize the trajectory tracking of the UAV under the external interference. Several simulations based on this proposed model have been performed and the results show that the designed controllers can make the quadrotor from any initial state reach the steady one according to the specified convergence time and have better convergence than Traditional Prescribed Performance Control (TPPC).

articleTitle: Structure Optimization of a Piezomagnetic Resistance Sensor Based on Orthogonal Experiment
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: The piezomagnetic resistance sensor of cross core was taken as the research object to ensure the minimum volume of the sensor under safe working conditions. The structure principle of piezomagnetic sensor was introduced. Based on the ANSYS Workbench software, the whole structure of the sensor was analyzed by finite element method. The stress and deformation distribution of the sensor were obtained. The main structural parameters of the sensor model were optimized by orthogonal experiment method, and the optimal structural parameters were determined. The results show that the resistance sensor of cross core was subjected to both horizontal and vertical forces, which improved the sensitivity of the sensor. By optimization, the comprehensive performance of the sensor was further improved. The maximum equivalent stress was reduced from 456.53 MPa to 298.95 MPa, which increased the safety margin. At the same time, the volume was reduced to 238.8mm, which reduced the manufacturing cost.

articleTitle: Study of Multi Ant Colony Genetic Algorithm in Query Optimization of Distributed Database
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: Under the background of "Internet plus" era, the amount of information in every field is increasing geometrically. Human beings are faced with massive data analysis and process every day.
