In this context, the application scenario of distributed database is gradually increasing. The speed of query operation is the key index that affects the efficiency of distributed database. A reasonable and efficient algorithm is of great practical significance to improve the query efficiency of database and to speed up the query process. In the past, a single conventional algorithm which was used to optimize query operations exposed some defects were exposed when a single conventional algorithm was used to optimize query operations, such as no planning, local advance into the optimal state local entry into optimal state in advance, long time of query and so on. In view of this, combined with the advantages of genetic algorithm and ant colony algorithm, this paper proposes a multi-ant colony genetic algorithm of query optimization of distributed database. Simulation results show that compared with traditional ant colony algorithm, the improved algorithm significantly enhances the execution ability and query efficiency of distributed database. In the aspect of optimization of distributed database, it has great value of promotion.

articleTitle: Vibration analysis of resonance fatigue testing machine
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: The ocean covers a much larger area of the earth than the land, in the case of diminishing land resources, the development of seabed resources is imperative. However, compared with the land, the deep-sea environment is more complex, risers and joints are important components in the mining process. In order to ensure the smooth operation process, it is necessary to study its fatigue life. The method is to estimate the fatigue life of the tested component by S-N curve. The device for measuring S-N curve is a resonance fatigue testing machine. According to its structural design, the actual constraints at both ends are not completely hinge constraints, and the mass distribution is mainly concentrated at both ends of the tested part. In order to further analyze its vibration response, the formula is derived again, so as to obtain the response in line with the actual work situation.

articleTitle: Indoor Vision Navigation and Target Tracking System for Aerial Robot
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: The guidance and precise control based on vision sensing is the key to realize the indoor positioning, navigation and tracking of aerial robot. Nowadays, vision sensing system shows great advantages in robot applications. This paper introduces an indoor vision navigation and target tracking system for aerial robot. The whole system consists of two parts: guidance platform and control platform. The guidance platform is composed of a processor and five stereoscopic sensor units, which enables the aerial robot mentioned in this paper to realize basic vision, including vision odometer, obstacle avoidance, SLAM, depth map generation, etc. The control platform involves flight control and pan-tilt control. The flight control adopts NAZA N3 module to collect the postures of the aerial robot through the built-in double IMU and control the four motors of the quadrotor to maintain stable flight. In the pan-tilt control part, the main control chip STM32F427IIH6 is equipped with MPU6500 gyro and IST8310 geomagnetic triaxial sensor. The level and pitch direction of pan-tilt are precisely controlled by stereo sensing unit to identify and track interesting targets.

articleTitle: Damage Tolerance Analysis of Double Hole-Opposite Crack at the Wing-Fuselage Joint of Civil Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: During the long term of flight task, to the structure of wing fuselage, the aircraft will cause multi-site damage due to fatigue load and other factors, which will reduce the residual strength of the structure rapidly and result in serious flight accidents. It is very important to do research on the reliability of multi-site damage. on the basis of single crack, the interaction between multi-site cracks is introduced, and the theory of single crack is extended to the propagation of multi-site cracks, calculating the stress intensity factors and interaction factors in various modes of multiple cracks. articleTitle: Research on the influence of TBM construction parameters on high pressure gas pipeline
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: According to the actual construction situation of the third underground section in the first phase of a subway construction section in Hangzhou, the settlement of underground pipelines is studied by analyzing the theory of Peck settlement trough and the foundation principle of elastic beam. The maximum allowable surface settlement of the horizontal section of the pipeline and the joint of the weld is calculated, and the maximum allowable surface settlement of the underground pipeline in the construction of shield tunnel in this project is taken as 20mm in combination with the actual construction situation.

articleTitle: Analysis and Numerical Simulation of Fatigue Propagation in Crack Front
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: In order to study the change rule of crack front edge morphology during fatigue crack propagation, the fracture toughness test of aluminum alloy was designed according to the test standard to obtain fatigue Crack front morphology; The distribution of stress intensity factor (SIF) at the crack front edge was studied by finite element simulation. The results show: penetration In the process of fatigue propagation, the front edge of the crack will evolve from the initial straight crack to the elliptic front crack.

articleTitle: Study on the Common Problems of Metrological Verification of Medical Equipment
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: The metrological verification of medical equipment is the guarantee of the stable performance of medical equipment and the premise and foundation of the treatment of all kinds of diseases, which plays an important role in hospital and medical service. At present, the demand for medical equipment is large, the relationship between doctors and patients is tight, and the requirement of metrological verification of medical equipment is higher. Therefore, it is necessary to analyze the common problems of metrological verification of medical equipment and put forward effective solutions. On the basis of discussing the importance of metrological verification of medical equipment, this work figured out three problems: the lack of clarity and unification of testing standards, the low qualified rate caused by the lack of inspection supervision, the weak consciousness of each medical subject and the low level of testing, and then discussed and explained how to solve these problems.

articleTitle: An Improved Image Classification Method for Specific Reality Environments
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: This paper proposes an improved image classification method based on specific data features and practical product requirements in the real enterprise environment. In order to make the model capable of filtering images outside the predefined classes and increasing the precision of the model, two probability thresholds are set at the last layer of the model, and "the uncertain class" is introduced to control the output of the model. The predefined classes are subdivided to sub-classes in training procedure and reassemble after training, which improves the stability and robustness of the model. A parallel architecture is also proposed to improve the efficiency of the entire system. The model is evaluated on a real image dataset collected by ourselves. Compared with the traditional deep model, the proposed method achieves faster convergence, higher accuracy and stability. Especially, it can filter out most of uncertain classes that traditional models cannot recognize. The system is already available in the practical enterprise environment, and it is highly efficient and extendable.

articleTitle: Study on Modeling Methods for Magnetic Field Intensity of Submarine Cables Based on WCA-SVM
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: With the popularization of submarine cables, the important role of submarine cables in the field of power transmission in China is becoming more and more prominent. In practical engineering, it is necessary to detect important indexes including the magnetic field and etc. during the monitoring of submarine cable state, but traditional modeling methods are complicated, with low precision and insufficient reliability. To solve this problem, a modeling method based on the measured data of submarine cable magnetic field intensity is proposed in this paper. In this method, the measured data of submarine cable magnetic field intensity are used as training samples, and the support vector machine (SVM) is used to train them and obtain the magnetic field intensity model. In order to improve the fitting accuracy of the model, the water circulation algorithm (WCA) is used to optimize the important parameters of SVM. The experimental results show that this method has the characteristics of high precision, strong reliability and simple modeling in fitting submarine cable magnetic field strength model.

articleTitle: High-speed Friction Predicted Model of Tread Rubber Based on Experimental
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: The friction behavior of tread rubber directly affect service life of aircraft tires. In this paper, the High-speed friction tester has been developed, and friction tests with different loads and speeds have been carried out. Here, a numerical High-speed friction model is developed based on the tests. Results indicate that the coefficient decreases when the speed and load increase, and there is a power function between the load and the contact pressure. Besides, a High-speed friction predicted model is developed, which considered the influence of contact presure and speed based on the Power function friction model.

articleTitle: Research on Automation System Framework and Key Technologies of Regional Integration Dispatching
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: The traditional command platform of power supply load in power grid has some problems, such as long command time and insufficient command actual effect. Aiming at the power supply load balance management of power grid, a dispatching integrated command platform is constructed through relevant intelligent technology. The system includes the modules of monitoring and analysis, dispatching plan, dispatching operation, dispatching management, and system management. Based on the key technologies such as foundation support technology, intelligent scheduling technology, intelligent decision technology and experimental verification technology, the automation system framework of regional integration dispatching can manage and monitor the internal information systems of power enterprises, achieve high integration and wide sharing of information, and improve the working efficiency of system application and user service.

articleTitle: Research on the 95th Dummy Injury Based on Interior Fittings of Passenger Car
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: At present, the standard of interior fittings test at home and abroad only regards the dummy head as the assessment index. However, the head, neck, chest, pelvis, leg and other parts of the dummy are taken as important evaluation indexes to evaluate the safety performance of vehicles in frontal crash regulations and C-NCAP (version 2021). In this paper, the 95th dummy injury for interior fittings of passenger car is studied by the sled impact test, the results show that the head, neck, chest and legs of the dummy were damaged in different degrees; Especially, the value of 95th dummy's pelvis displacement is too large, which makes the lower body of the dummy more seriously damaged. Therefore, it is suggested that multiple parts of the dummy and its damage index should be considered appropriately in the test and evaluation method for the interior fittings of passenger car, so as to continuously improve the automobile safety standard system in China, further improve the vehicle safety performance, and have a better protection for the safety of occupants.

articleTitle: Detection device of steel rope of the strop
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: In order to detect the damage of the wire rope of the sliding rope in large amusement facilities, it is necessary to ensure its safe operation, ensure the safety of tourists and avoid safety accidents. A nondestructive testing device based on electromagnetic effect is designed. The magnetic leakage detection principle is adopted to capture the damage leakage field on the strop, and cooperate with the robot to detect the cable. The device can effectively detect the cable damage, and can quantitatively analyze the broken wire damage, including the number of broken wires and the width of the broken wires. A large number of experimental results show that the device is very effective for the quantitative detection of broken wires of the strop, which fills the technical gap that strop cannot be detected.

articleTitle: Rocket booster recovery analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: Under normal circumstances, rocket launches are for one-time use, so the cost is relatively high. In order to improve this situation, many countries have carried out research on how to reduce costs. If the rocket can be recovered after it is launched, and the launch can be continued after the repair is completed, the rocket launch cost can be greatly reduced. In the recovery rocket program, the frequently used recovery program is vertical return. Compared with land recycling, marine recycling has more technical problems and technical difficulties. This paper studies the rocket booster's vertical return to the offshore platform, analyzes its technical indicators, and discusses related technologies, proposes measures to solve this type of problem, and provides references for Chinese researchers to study related content.

articleTitle: Design of Separating Structure of Small Satellite with Elastic Metal
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: The development of modern science and technology is closely related to satellites. In order to enhance the overall national strength, various countries are launching satellites. Compared with large satellites, small satellites have more advantages, such as lower capital investment, lower risk and higher performance, and therefore become a core of future aviation technology. When researching the technology of small satellites, a key issue is the separation of satellites and arrows. There is a close relationship between this technology and the performance of small satellites, which will affect whether the satellite can be successfully launched. Due to the short research time of small satellites and the imperfect development of separation technology, this technology has many shortcomings, such as not having high reliability and having a large separation impact. Therefore, it is necessary to conduct research in this field, design and optimize related technologies, so as to improve the separation of small satellites and rockets. In this paper, the research on the separation technology of small satellites, stars and arrows is carried out, and the elastic metal unlocking device is discussed, which lays the foundation for the improvement of the technical level. The research content of this article can provide technical support for relevant personnel and also provide research directions for researchers in this field.

articleTitle: Ploughing Test and Analysis of High Speed Flip Plough
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: In order to reduce the working energy consumption and improve the working efficiency, this paper studies the effects of soil moisture content, soil compactness and soil adhesion on ploughing resistance. After field experiments, the effects of single factors on ploughing resistance are compared. It can be seen from the experiments that the surface compaction is higher than that of the bottom layer, With the increase of soil surface compactness, the ploughing resistance increases, and with the increase of adhesion, the ploughing resistance increases. According to the orthogonal experiment of three factors and three levels, the results show that moisture content is 17.48 % and soil compactness is 230.82 N/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and the ploughing resistance is minimum when the adhesion force is 1.9 N. This study provides a theoretical reference for reducing energy consumption and improving efficiency in high-speed turnover plow operation.

articleTitle: The Research Status and Development of Personal Cooling Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: Personal cooling systems (PCSs) have been commonly used to relieve the risk of heat strain when exposed to hot environments. This review introduces PCSs on cooling principle, classification and test methods. Then, predicting the development trend of PCSs. According to different cooling medium, PCSs are classified into three types: air cooling systems, liquid cooling systems and phase change cooling systems, introducing the working principle, advantages and disadvantages respectively. In addition, the characteristics of three testing methods of PCSs (i.e., mathematical modeling, manikin testing and human trial) are summarized, and manikin testing includes three operation conditions: constant skin temperature mode, constant heat flux mode and thermoregulatory model control mode. Furthermore, the development trend of PCSs in features, standardize and accurate test as well as evaluation system are predicted.

articleTitle: Multi-crack study on fuselage of civil aircraft
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: Taking the aluminum alloy siding of the fuselage as the research object, through experiment, theory and finite element analysis, the residual strength of the structure with specific cracks was studied. This paper introduces the theory of residual strength. The elastoplastic finite element method is improved, which can effectively improve the prediction accuracy and is suitable for the residual strength evaluation of multi-crack thick plate with complex crack configuration.

articleTitle: Study on rapid preparation of self-cleaning superhydrophobic 304 stainless steel surface using nanosecond laser
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: The superhydrophobic surface was prepared by nanosecond laser on 304 stainless steel in this paper. After laser and low temperature heat treatment, the surface of stainless steel is transformed from hydrophilic to hydrophobic. The use of lauric acid in the heating process makes the surface of 304 stainless steel become superhydrophobic and self-cleaning, and the contact angle reaches upto 159.36°. The low temperature heat treatment accelerates the wettability transition process, and the use of organic matter significantly improves the hydrophobic performance. Self-cleaning stainless steel plate surface can be widely used in a variety of food machinery, convenient cleaning.

articleTitle: Research on Calibration Device of Falling Weight Deflectometer Based on the Absolute Method
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: Road deflection is an indicator of the overall strength of the road and the falling weight deflectometer is the main instrument for measuring this parameter in China. This paper introduces the composition of the calibration devices, analyzes the concept of designing the device, describes the calibration parameters as well as carries out the test verification and uncertainty evaluation. The test results indicates that the device improves the accuracy of the falling weight deflectometer effectively.

articleTitle: An Optimized Rollover Index for Articulated Steering Vehicle on Slopes
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: The lateral load transfer rate(LTR), as a rollover index, is widely used in conventional vehicle stability control. However, the LTR cannot be applied to the articulated steering vehicles(ASV) directly due to its varying center of gravity. In this paper, considering the overall dynamic of ASV and the posture on the slope without calculating its tire deformations, we propose the avLTR as a rollover index for ASV. The validity of avLTR is verified on a 1:5 prototype driving on dangerous conditions. The experimental results show that avLTR can be used to assess the lateral stability of ASV. The avLTR is beneficial for the lateral stability control and intelligent driving of ASV.

articleTitle: Analysis of sinusoidal vibration in mechanical environment of satellite Laser communication terminal telescope
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: Sinusoidal vibration is the most severe mechanical environment experienced during the mission period of the satellite laser communication terminal telescope, and it is also the difficulty and emphasis of the prediction of the environment of the satellite laser communication terminal telescope. Based on the satellite laser communication terminal telescope sine vibration test appraisal level conditions using Solidworks software model of the organization of the telescope, for X, Y, Z three directions of sine sweep, finite element analysis software can be simulated by harmonic response analysis, through the way of input frequency sweep acceleration amplitude, the sinusoidal response to a certain frequency range is analyzed. Sinusoidal analysis and impact response analysis show that the internal deformation of the model is small and the stress is less than the allowable stress of the structural materials. When subjected to impact response, the maximum stress of glass lens is 21Mpa. Meet the use requirements under the given mechanical environmental conditions.

articleTitle: Digital Twin Technology in Intelligent Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: At present, digital twin (DT), as the key-enabling technology to promote the development of intelligent manufacturing, has become a research hotspot. To deepen the understanding of digital twin technology, the development course of the DT concept was reviewed. Then the basic connotation of DT was clarified and the hierarchical structure of digital twin technology was described. In the end, the five key generic technologies and three technical bottlenecks of DT were emphatically introduced, and the direction for its future development was pointed out.

articleTitle: Multipath Time of Arrival Estimation Algorithm Based on Successive Interference Cancellation in NB-IoT Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: Narrow-band Internet of Things (NB-IoT) is a radio access technology of 5G with super coverage, low power, low cost, massive connections and a reduced set of functionalities. The NB-IoT systems are widely applied in industry such as smart transportation and smart community. Many NB-IoT industrial applications need a positioning feature for tracking and equipment monitoring. The Observed Time Difference of Arrival (OTDOA) is a downlink positioning method in NB-IoT systems, in which a User Equipment (UE) measures the Time of Arrival (TOA) of narrowband positioning reference signals (NPRS) from multiple base stations (eNodeBs). These TOAs from several neighbor eNodeBs are subtracted from a TOA of a reference eNodeB to form Reference Signal Time Difference (RSTD) measurements, which are reported to the networks for the UE positioning. A UE can obtain TOA by measuring the time delay of the first tap in the estimated channel impulse response. The performance of TOA/OTDOA estimation suffers from 180 kHz bandwidth limitation, low sampling-rate and low-cost in NB-IoT systems, especially under multipath channel and inter-cell interference environment. This paper proposes an enhanced multipath time of arrival estimation algorithm to improve the accuracy of TOA/OTDOA estimation by detecting the first channel tap in an estimated channel impulse response, estimating the frequency offset and channel parameters of each received signal, cancelling interfering signals from inter-cells iteratively and interpolating the correlations of time-domain NPRS signal evaluated at low sampling rate to a high sampling rate of 61.44MHz. The performance of the proposed method is evaluated via simulation. The performance of TOA/OTDOA estimation is shown to outperform the performance of conventional TOA estimation techniques that uses signal-to-noise fixed threshold or non-iterative method.

articleTitle: Recognition of important Korean text structure based on Reinforcement Learning and Self-attention mechanism
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the artificial tagging of Korean corpus is too time-consuming and laborious, and it is difficult for minority languages to integrate with various resources. We intend to construct an effective Korean structural representation from the perspective of representation learning to improve the effectiveness of subsequent natural language processing tasks. Combining deep reinforcement learning with Self-attention mechanism, we propose a hierarchical self-attention model (Hierarchically Structured Korean, HS-K). By using the Actor-Critic idea in reinforcement learning, the model takes the text classification effect as the label feedback of reinforcement learning, and transforms the text structure division task into the sequence decision task. The experimental results show that the model can identify the important text structure of Korean which closer the manual tagging, and it has a friendly auxiliary effect on Korean informatization and intelligentialize.

articleTitle: Distribution Network Equipment Fault Prediction and Maintenance Path Optimization Strategy Based on Deep Learning and Knowledge Map Comprehensive Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: In view of the dynamic real-time nature of the distribution network faults, the difficulty of forecasting, and the difficulty of fault inspection path planning, this paper proposes a strategy for fault prediction and maintenance path optimization of distribution network equipment based on deep learning-knowledge graph comprehensive analysis. First, use the comprehensive analysis strategy based on deep learning-knowledge map to predict the failure of the distribution network equipment, and perform statistical analysis according to the size of the prediction result. Then, according to the predicted health status of the equipment, the quantum genetic algorithm is used to optimize the inspection path of the distribution net-work inspector. According to the optimization result, the optimal inspection path of the distribution network inspector is finally obtained. The results of the calculation example show that based on the deep learning-knowledge map comprehensive analysis method, the model loss value is reduced to about 0.2, which meets the prediction accuracy. And the use of quantum genetic algorithm to optimize the inspection path compared with the traditional genetic algorithm, the objective function value is reduced by about 50%, thereby reducing the path length of the inspector and saving inspection time.

articleTitle: Blockchain Bookkeeping Optimization Scheme Based on Threshold Ring Signature
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: According to the characteristics of blockchain data concurrent processing, the threshold ring signature algorithm is improved by combining ring signature and threshold signature scheme. Threshold is set to dynamically adjust the number of threshold ring signature nodes, and threshold ring signature process is designed. By modifying the block data structure of Dag, the concept of redundant transaction is proposed and its formal definition is given. According to the type of redundant transaction, the transaction optimization processing method is given, the group verification is realized by Threshold Ring Signature, and the DAG bookkeeping optimization scheme based on threshold ring signature is given, signature security, transaction deletion security and chain security are analyzed. Finally, a simulation experiment was conducted through the concurrent execution of the block data construction program and the optimization program, and the results show that the optimization scheme basically does not affect the execution time of the program and the storage efficiency is significantly improved.

articleTitle: Research on the Transfer of Patented Technology in the UAV Field among Provinces Based on Social Network Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacture (AIAM)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to collect patent transfer data from 2014 to 2018 in China's UAV (Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) field, build a patent transfer network, and analyze the current status of patent transfer in this field; based on the perspective of social networks, explore the current status of China's provinces in the UVA field and come up with the future suggestions for development. The significance of the paper is to understand the characteristics of the interprovincial transaction network structure. And also, the paper provides countermeasures for promoting technology trading among provinces. Results show that the number of transferred patents between provinces increases, but they mainly occur in Beijing, Guangdong, Zhejiang, Jiangsu, etc. Other provinces still have great potential in UAV field to be explored. The conclusion is that in the future we can encourage the core provinces in UAV field to transfer technology to those who are marginalized; technology-radiating provinces could establish research stations in technology-absorbing provinces in order to improve the harmonious development of both sides.
